description: Growth pillar indicators, the detail behind the Business cycle card of get_dashboard (its Growth, Jobs and Investment rows) and the regime's Mood row: industrial production (IPMAN, the ISM proxy), consumer sentiment (U Michigan), the 2s10s yield curve, initial claims, plus the Atlanta Fed GDPNow nowcast of the quarter in progress. growth_vote_inputs holds the three inputs of the business cycle's growth vote, each with its word and dated observation: output (IPMAN three-month change), jobs (initial claims four-week average against twelve weeks earlier) and investment (BEA real private fixed investment in information-processing equipment and software, A679RX1Q020SBEA, year on year, with its quarter), plus the vote's rule; the vote itself is applied in get_macro_regime. GDPNow carries its own reference_quarter, the publication date of the estimate, and the previous estimate of the SAME quarter, so its direction of travel is readable; it is reported, not scored, so it does not move the classification. When no estimate is on file the block reports status: unavailable and says so in staleness_flags — not published, which is not the same as zero. Returns classification (green/yellow/red), the growth pillar's own score, separate from the vote; read_complete is false when a series failed to read.
name: get_growth_indicators
title: Get growth indicators
